decisions.reason: The charting bundle was publicly launched as a map.apps extension with repeated releases, so sunk development effort and its tie to the core map.apps line favor keeping it, even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

VueTOC was announced on the home page as a new solution approach, which creates a commitment to justify, but as a small component with no website presence after 2018 it is a likely candidate to be folded into other offerings.
The GIS platform is the firm's flagship product line and central to its announced direction, so heavy investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
The field data capture software fits the firm's core mobile GIS offer and had a dedicated page, so weak visibility can still be attributed to temporary adoption delays rather than failure.
